strings.При первом включении/обновлении Windows: On first activation or after an update, Windows may show one UAC prompt to register the system module. After that, the passphrase creates a short-lived protected request that LogonUI passes to Winlogon/LSA. The password itself is never written to disk in plain text. NEO must still be running and able to hear the microphone in an existing user session.
strings.Семейство NEO включает Cyan, Orange, Blu: The NEO family includes Cyan, Orange, Blue, Purple, Yellow, Green, Red, Gray, Dark, Full Dark and White. You can choose the same preset for the window and robot or mix different ones; changes take effect after Apply or Save.
strings.Музыкальная волна больше не настраиваетс: The music waveform no longer has separate settings: when NEO plays music on the computer or in Discord, a compact equalizer automatically appears on the robot’s body and disappears when playback stops or pauses.
strings.Создание, редактирование, перенос, переи: Creating, editing, moving, renaming and deleting TO THE RECYCLE BIN do not require confirmation. Permanent deletion and protected system folders remain blocked or require separate confirmation.
strings.Непрерывный режим подходит для разговора: Continuous mode suits a conversation with a series of commands and ends with a stop phrase. Single-command mode works like a classic assistant: wake word → one command and response → wait for the wake word again.
strings.Общий верхний предел ответа. Для коротки: Response length limit for image analysis. Applies only to screenshot requests; ordinary commands and conversations are not sent to Ollama.
strings.Используется только для критичных удалён: Used only for critical remote actions. Stored on disk using Windows DPAPI. The Telegram message containing the passphrase is deleted immediately after verification and is not mirrored to the local chat.
strings.Обязателен для Google AI Mode. На Window: Required for Google Search via SearchAPI.io. On Windows, the key is stored using DPAPI and never appears in logs or URLs. The SEARCHAPI_API_KEY environment variable is used only as a fallback when this field is empty.
strings.Фильтрует короткие щелчки клавиатуры/мыш: Filters short keyboard and mouse clicks, breathing and steady noise before recognition. The recommended range is 45–65%; a setting that is too high may cut off very quiet speech.
strings.Во время длинной команды выполняется не: During a long command, no more than one preliminary recognition pass runs. The recommended setting is 2.0 seconds; frequent overlapping requests are disabled for stability.
strings.Параметры бывшего раздела «Поведение» пе: Settings from the former Behavior section have moved here: personality, voice dialogue mode, barge-in and audio ducking are now alongside the microphone and wake word settings.
strings.Нужна мультимодальная модель, умеющая пр: Choose a multimodal model that accepts screenshots, such as Qwen3.5:4b. Ollama is used only for image analysis. The inherited text-model setting does not enable a fallback for conversations or ordinary commands.
strings.Удалённое подключение полностью перенесе: Remote access has moved entirely to Security, including Telegram, owner linking, critical actions and restrictions on remote commands.
strings.Создайте приложение в Spotify Developer: Create an application in the Spotify Developer Dashboard. For desktop use, NEO uses Authorization Code + PKCE, so a Client Secret is neither required nor stored.
strings.Все пользовательские данные NEO теперь н: All NEO user data now resides under one root folder, LocalAppData/NeoJarvis. The old Roaming/NeoJarvis folder is migrated here automatically.
strings.При удержании горячей клавиши история ча: Holding the hotkey scrolls the chat history smoothly downwards. At the very bottom, automatic following of the response is enabled again.
strings.По одному варианту на строку. Добавляйте: One variant per line. Add alternative pronunciations and speech recognition errors here. The list is stored in settings, not in Python code.
strings.Глобальный хоткей выключает только просл: The global hotkey turns off microphone listening only within NEO. The Windows system microphone and other applications are unaffected.
strings.Только эти точные имена/username можно и: Only these exact names or usernames can be used in a voice command to send a message. The recipient must have previously appeared in Secretary Mode.
strings.Одноразовый код действует 15 минут. Отпр: The one-time code is valid for 15 minutes. Send the displayed command to your Telegram bot. Once successful, the code is deleted automatically.
strings.Размер текста сообщений в чате в пикселя: Chat message text size in pixels. It changes independently of the window size and does not resize buttons or utility controls.
strings.Должен точно совпадать с URI приложения: Must exactly match the Spotify application URI. Use loopback address 127.0.0.1, for example http://127.0.0.1:8765/callback.
strings.Все быстрые голосовые команды транспорта: All quick voice playback controls are grouped in Media. When disabled, the same commands require the wake word.
strings.Постоянный атмосферный эффект на сцене р: A persistent background effect behind the robot: rain, snow, shooting stars, clouds, starry sky or fireflies.
strings.Отправка в группу разрешается только при: Sending to a group is allowed only if it exactly matches this list and a previously observed Business chat.
strings.Двухбуквенный ISO-код, например RU, NL,: Two-letter ISO code, for example RU, NL or DE. Also used to determine public holidays.
strings.Кэш хранит только итоговый Google AI отв: The cache stores search results and source information, not game databases or entire websites.
strings.После этой короткой паузы имя сразу отпр: After this short pause, the name is sent for recognition immediately. The recommended setting is 0.30–0.40 seconds.

strings.Для запросов «сейчас», «последний патч»,: Queries such as “right now”, “latest patch” and “current meta” use a short cache lifetime (TTL).

strings.Чем выше значение, тем строже Atlas прин: The higher the value, the more strictly Atlas accepts flexible wording. NEO's compact local vectors use a lower scale than transformer embeddings: the recommended value is 0.43. Dangerous commands and commands targeting a specific object are never executed on similarity alone; they still pass through the normal SecurityPolicy.
strings.Типы: app, game, folder, file, discord_c: Types: app, game, folder, file, discord_channel, term. For a complex application, you can specify its full path and several pronunciation variants. Matches are used only with high confidence to avoid accidentally opening a similar object.
strings.Адаптивный повтор не запускает Whisper д: Adaptive retry does not run Whisper twice all the time: a second pass is used only for a suspicious transcript, such as very low confidence, an unexpected writing system, or text that is too short for a long recording.
NEO deletes only known messages belonging to NEO, in batches. It does not scan arbitrary message ID ranges. On exit, a short cleanup of the current session avoids delaying the next launch.
strings.Семейство NEO включает Cyan, Orange, Blu: The NEO family includes Cyan, Orange, Blue, Purple, Yellow, Green, Red, Gray, Dark, Full Dark and White. The same presets are available for the robot; changes take effect only after Apply or Save.
strings.Команды громкости управляют только локал: Volume commands control only local Yandex/Spotify/YouTube Audio playback and never change Discord's volume. Repeat and shuffle also work without the wake word when enabled here.
strings.Tiny рекомендуется для постоянного фонов: Tiny is recommended for continuous background wake-word detection: it is considerably lighter, and the expanded variant list compensates for common errors with the short name. Base/Small remain available for manual selection.
strings.Интервал между символами. Меньше — текст: Delay between characters. A smaller value makes text appear faster. This setting applies to completed API/tool responses and streamed responses without changing the model's actual generation speed.
strings.После окончания речи всегда выполняется: Once speech ends, a separate high-quality recognition pass always runs. Faster-whisper runs in an isolated process and restarts automatically after a native crash.
strings.Единая частота кадров для робота, индика: Shared frame rate for the robot, indicators, character-by-character text and music waveform. The maximum is 60 FPS to avoid wasting CPU; audio and speech recognition run independently.
strings.Положение и размер каждого включённого э: Use the mouse in edit mode to set the position and size of each enabled item. In normal mode, the information overlay is entirely borderless and lets mouse input pass through.
strings.По одному полному пути на строку. При по: Enter one full path per line. With full user access, this list does not restrict ordinary folders; Windows/Program Files/ProgramData remain protected.
strings.Рекомендуется 1,2–1,3 секунды: это лучше: Recommended: 1.2–1.3 seconds, to preserve quiet endings of phrases. With a low noise cutoff, Whisper’s internal VAD does not trim the command further.
strings.Каждый блок можно включать независимо. П: Each section can be enabled independently. Full computer details follow the same CPU → GPU → RAM → drives order as the system status command.
strings.В окне Developer видно speech → normaliz: The Developer window shows speech → normalized text → intent/entities → tool/fallback → latency → result. It only observes and does not affect actions.
strings.Добавьте сюда реальные варианты, которым: Add the actual variants Whisper may produce when hearing your passphrase. Matching is exact after normalization; approximate matches cannot unlock access.
strings.Управление воспроизведением выполняется: Playback is controlled through the official Spotify Web API / Spotify Connect. Spotify’s playback endpoints require Premium.
The gl parameter sets the region for Google results. General and game-related questions use Google search through SearchAPI.io; the language of source excerpts depends on the results returned.
strings.Порог намеренно строгий: ниже 82% значен: The threshold is deliberately strict and cannot be set below 82%, to prevent ordinary words and noise from activating the assistant. Recommended: 88–92%.
strings.Для команд рекомендуется small: заметно: For commands, small is recommended: it is noticeably more accurate than tiny and handles mixed Russian and English better. With a capable NVIDIA GPU, you can choose turbo.
strings.Сколько ждать начала ответа. Для прогрет: How long to wait for image-analysis output to begin. Loading the model from a cold start may take longer; a shorter timeout detects a stalled request sooner.
strings.Если снять «Отображать робота», вся верх: If you turn off “Show robot”, the entire animated area at the top disappears, and the chat automatically fills the freed space.
strings.Сколько ссылок Google AI Mode сохранять: How many source links to save alongside the answer in the local SearchAPI.io results cache. This does not increase the number of search requests.
strings.Создайте Google Cloud project, включите: Create a Google Cloud project, enable YouTube Data API v3, and create an API key. NEO does not ask for your YouTube/Google password.
strings.По одной фразе на строку. Они завершают: One phrase per line. These phrases end only a continuous voice session; they are not needed in single-command mode.
strings.Максимальное ожидание одного HTTPS-запро: Maximum wait for one HTTPS request. Game Web does not launch Chromium/Edge, CDP, or a Google browser profile.
strings.Используется для уведомлений и списков п: Used for email notifications and lists. The content includes only a short preview of the beginning of the email.
Used for email notifications and lists. The content is a short, safe preview without attachments.
strings.Нужен для проверки владельца сессии. В s: Required to verify the session owner. Only a value encrypted with Windows DPAPI is saved in settings.json.
strings.Журналы работы, launcher/instance diagno: Application logs, launcher and instance diagnostics, and crash recovery files share one NEO folder tree.
strings.Короткое окно быстрее отдаёт wake word н: A shorter window sends the wake word for recognition sooner. Recommended: 2.2–2.7 seconds.
strings.Сколько хранить ответы по стабильным мех: How long to keep results about stable game mechanics before repeating the Google search through SearchAPI.io.
strings.0–20% — точнее и предсказуемее для коман: Controls variation in image-analysis responses only. Lower values make wording more predictable; higher values allow more variation. It does not affect dialogue or command routing.
strings.Data API key не настроен; прямые URL и т: Data API key is not configured; direct URLs and browser playback remain available
strings.Запись остановится автоматически, даже е: Recording stops automatically, even if background noise continues.
strings.Ключ OpenWeather хранится локально в DPA: The OpenWeather key is stored locally, encrypted with DPAPI.
strings.Блокировка единственного экземпляра и IP: NEO’s single-instance lock and interprocess communication (IPC) state.
strings.0% полностью скрывает внешние и внутренн: 0% completely hides both outer and inner borders.
The name shown on the robot’s messages.
strings.Пауза завершает wake-фразу: Pause that ends the wake phrase
strings.Подключён: {account}. Нажмите «Применить: Connected: {account}. Select Apply or Save to store tokens with DPAPI.
strings.Не удалось обновить список микрофонов: {: Could not refresh the microphone list: {error}
strings.Ждём подтверждение. Код: {code}. Страниц: Awaiting confirmation. Code: {code}. The Yandex page is open in your browser.
strings.Меняет интерфейс, язык ответов и словарь: Changes the interface, reply language and command dictionary. Only the selected language’s dictionary is active; other dictionaries are loaded when you switch languages. Track, file, website and application names, and other user-written text, stay unchanged.
strings.Пример: «рабочий режим». В колонке пути: Example: “work mode”. In the path column, enter exe files, shortcuts or files, one per line. Under “Monitors”, enter 3,2,1 in the same order; 0 or a blank value means the window will not be moved. More complex steps can be added directly to settings.json using steps: wait/command.
strings.PortAudio работает в отдельном subproces: PortAudio runs in a separate subprocess and automatically tries safe Windows audio backends if an error occurs. Start with the system’s default microphone; select a specific device only when needed.
strings.0 = автоматическая. В режиме редактирова: 0 = automatic. In edit mode, a thin handle appears between the robot scene and the chat. Drag it up or down: the robot shrinks or returns to its normal size to fit the remaining space.
strings.Не подключён. Одного переключателя Secre: Not connected. Enabling Secretary Mode in BotFather is not enough: connect this bot in Telegram → Settings → Telegram Business → Chatbots/Secretary, select the available chats and grant the Reply permission.
strings.Guild ID и User ID вводить больше не нуж: Guild ID and User ID are optional. NEO selects an accessible server and an occupied voice channel when the choice is unambiguous; otherwise, specify the channel. When the shared queue is enabled, installations synchronize it through NEO Bot.
strings.Экран и Vision используются только для ф: Screen capture and image analysis run when explicitly requested. Music, Discord, notes, checklists, conversation and ordinary commands do not trigger background screenshots.
strings.0% — полностью заглушить другие аудиосес: 0% completely mutes other audio sessions; 15–25% is usually enough. In single-command mode, volume is restored after the action or reply; in continuous conversation, after the stop phrase.
strings.Выберите один локальный музыкальный серв: Choose one local music service. Yandex Music and Spotify are available independently of the interface language; only one local service can be selected at a time. Discord and YouTube are configured separately.
strings.Настройки робота отделены от окна. Атмос: Robot settings are separate from window settings. Atmospheric effects, appearance, information elements and persistent accessories apply across all normal robot states and animations.
strings.Проверка выполняется уже внутри NEO пере: The check runs inside NEO before the tool starts. Scenarios from NEO’s local settings are allowed separately and run only when their exact saved name is specified.
strings.Введите названия через ;. Gmail: поддерж: Separate names with ;. Gmail supports custom labels, as well as Newsletters/Promotions, Social, Updates, Forums, Sent and Sent to self.
strings.Семейство шрифта только для сообщений, и: Font family for chat messages, author names, thinking text and technical details only. The list displays 6 rows and scrolls with the mouse wheel or scrollbar.
strings.Больше — легче услышать тихую речь. Для: Higher values make quiet speech easier to detect. A desktop microphone typically needs 88–96%. Increase it for quiet speech; lower it if background noise triggers recording too easily.
strings.Для полностью «голого» интерфейса выстав: For a completely stripped-back interface, set the window background, panels, chat, messages, controls and borders to 0%. Text and interactive areas remain available.
strings.Токен проверяется через официальный Tele: The token is verified through the official Telegram Bot API. Only a DPAPI-encrypted value for the current Windows user is saved to disk.
strings.Только официальный NEO Bot/API. Сервер и: Only NEO Bot and the official API are used. The server and voice channel are detected automatically; the Discord desktop app, pyautogui and UI fallback are not used.
strings.Используется только пароль для внешнего: Only a Mail.ru app password is used. It is stored using Windows DPAPI; do not enter your regular mailbox password here.
strings.Кружка и руки по умолчанию подхватывают: By default, the mug and hands use the selected robot’s palette. After choosing a preset, you can change each of these colors separately.
strings.NEO открывает найденное видео в выбранно: NEO opens the video it finds in the selected browser and controls the active YouTube media session using safe playback commands.
strings.Как часто проверять, продолжает ли работ: How often to check whether the game process is still running. This is only a lightweight process check; no game databases are used.
strings.API key нужен для голосового поиска виде: An API key is required to search for a video by title using voice. No key is needed for an already open video or a direct youtube.com link.
strings.Если включить Spotify, этот тумблер выкл: Enabling Spotify automatically turns this switch off: NEO allows only one active music provider.
Enter the exact Mail.ru IMAP folder names, separated by ;. Russian names and nested folders are also supported.
strings.При удержании горячей клавиши история ча: Holding the hotkey smoothly scrolls the chat history upwards and automatically stops following the response being generated.
strings.Хранится локально в DPAPI-зашифрованном: Stored locally, encrypted with DPAPI. For a Desktop app, this is part of the OAuth configuration, not your Gmail password.
strings.Обычно определяется автоматически. Для M: Usually detected automatically. For a Microsoft account, you can enter MicrosoftAccount\email@example.com.
strings.NEO использует числовой ID, а не @userna: NEO uses a numeric ID, not an @username. This version supports only one linked owner.
strings.Во время тяжёлых игр лучше выбрать выгру: The model is unloaded after image analysis to free memory. Automatic preloading and keeping the model loaded for conversations are disabled.
strings.Создайте OAuth 2.0 Client ID типа Deskto: Create an OAuth 2.0 Client ID of type Desktop app in Google Cloud. NEO does not ask for your Gmail password.
strings.Персональный словарь, сценарии и горячие: The personal dictionary, scenarios, and keyboard shortcuts are grouped in one additional section.
strings.Скорость можно менять и голосом: «выстав: You can also change the speed by voice: “Set the autoclicker speed to 10 clicks per second.”
strings.Размер меняется вместе с окном; этот пар: The size adjusts with the window; this setting applies an additional scale factor.
strings.Обычно менять не нужно. Стандартный адре: Usually no change is needed. Default Ollama address: http://localhost:11434
strings.Высота основного окна в пикселях. Окно т: Main window height in pixels. You can also resize the window manually.
strings.Ручной резервный способ. Токен хранится: Manual fallback method. The token is stored using Windows DPAPI.
strings.Выгружать сразу — меньше VRAM, ответ зап: Unload immediately — uses less VRAM; the next analysis may start more slowly
strings.medium — точнее, тяжелее: medium — more accurate, uses more resources
strings.Проверяет включённые сервисы при сборе с: Checks enabled services while preparing the briefing. Does not start music or send messages. Weather and YouTube requests may use API quota.
strings.Быстрые команды без wake word (клип / за: Quick commands without the wake word (clip / record / stop recording / screenshot)
strings.Клип сохраняет последние минуты через «М: A clip saves the last minutes through NVIDIA Instant Replay; its length (for example 5 minutes) is set in the NVIDIA App overlay. NEO presses the overlay hotkeys and tells you where the file was saved.
strings.Как часто NEO слушает микрофон, наскольк: How often NEO listens to the microphone, how closely it looks at the screen and how long the vision model stays in memory. The profile is applied after saving.
strings.Отвечать на вопросы и разговаривать чере: Answer questions and talk through the local model (no internet)
strings.Запоминать мои предпочтения, названия ко: Remember my preferences, command names and corrections
strings.Понимать перефразированные команды модел: Understand rephrased commands with the NEO command model
strings.Дообучать модель команд ночью, когда ком: Retrain the command model at night when the computer is idle
strings.Подробный журнал: записывать тексты запр: Detailed log: record request and answer texts (for diagnostics)
strings.Память: «что ты обо мне запомнил», «забу: Memory: “what do you remember about me”, “forget …”, “clear saved memory”. File search: “allow searching the folder Documents”. Command model: “show the command model status”.
strings.Уведомление о запуске игры: Notify when a game is launched
strings.Уведомление о начале игровой сессии (окн: Notify when a game session starts (game window first in front)
strings.Уведомление о завершении сессии с её дли: Notify when a session ends, with its duration
strings.Уведомление о готовности матча: Notify when a match is ready
strings.Присылать готовность матча в Telegram (с: Send match ready to Telegram (with an “Accept” button)
strings.Уведомления появляются в чате NEO. Готов: Notices appear in the NEO chat. Match ready is also shown in the Windows notification area.
strings.Предупреждать при запуске игры, если мгн: Warn at game launch if Instant Replay is off
strings.Автоматически включать мгновенный повтор: Turn Instant Replay on automatically when a game starts and it is off (NEO will tell you)
strings.Сообщать, если мгновенный повтор включил: Tell me if Instant Replay turns on or off during a game
strings.Напоминать проверить повтор, если NVIDIA: Remind me to check the replay if NVIDIA doesn’t report its state
strings.Голосом: «включи мгновенный повтор», «вы: By voice: “turn on instant replay”, “turn off instant replay”, “is instant replay on?”. NEO presses the NVIDIA overlay toggle hotkey (Alt+Shift+F10 by default) and reads the state NVIDIA keeps in the user registry. If NVIDIA doesn’t report the state, NEO doesn’t press the toggle blindly.
strings.Модель ассистента NEO: разговор и выполн: NEO assistant model: conversation and requests in your own words
strings.Дообучать модель ассистента на командах: Fine-tune the assistant model on NEO's commands in the background while the computer is idle
strings.Устанавливаю модель в фоне. Прогресс — в: Installing the model in the background. Progress is in the NEO log; you can keep working.
strings.Модель ассистента понимает просьбы своим: The assistant model understands requests in your own words and turns them into NEO commands (for example: “open the browser, google a borscht recipe and go to the first site”), and answers questions itself. Every action goes through the same checks and confirmations as an ordinary command.
strings.Чашка кофе — держит в руке и иногда отпи: Coffee cup — holds it and takes a sip now and then
strings.Кружка и руки по умолчанию подхватывают: By default, the mug and hands use the selected robot’s palette. After choosing a preset, you can change each of these colors separately. Coffee and cigarette can be on together: the mug on the right, the cigarette on the left.
strings.Запоминать понятые опечатки и фразы, что: Remember typos and phrasings I understood, to answer at once next time (short commands and greetings only, on this computer)
strings.Лог ещё не создан: {path}: The log has not been created yet: {path}
strings.Параметр находится в свёрнутой интеграци: This setting is inside a collapsed integration. Turn it on to see the field.
strings.Имя для персонального обращения. По умол: Name used to address you personally. Empty by default. The box on the right turns on addressing you by name in every answer; when it is off the name is not used. The name is kept exactly as typed and is never translated.
strings.translategemma:4b — около 3,3 ГБ, быстра: translategemma:4b — about 3.3 GB, fast, suits most computers. translategemma:12b — about 8.1 GB, more accurate but slower and needs more memory.
strings.TranslateGemma — открытая модель перевод: TranslateGemma is an open translation model from Google (55 languages). It runs on this computer through Ollama: the text is not sent anywhere and uses no SearchAPI requests. Without it, translation goes through SearchAPI.io and uses your free daily requests. Download progress is shown here and in the chat.
strings.Используется, когда язык не назван в про: Used when the request names no language. “Automatic”: into the interface language, and text already in the interface language into English.
strings.Спрашивать об установке модели, если её: Ask to install the model when it is missing
strings.Если локальная модель не ответила — пере: If the local model does not answer, translate through SearchAPI
strings.Указывать в ответе, чем выполнен перевод: Say in the answer what translated it
strings.Держать модель в памяти после перевода: Keep the model in memory after a translation
strings.0 — выгружать сразу. Пока модель в памят: 0 — unload at once. While the model is in memory the next translation starts faster; afterwards the memory is freed.
strings.Длинный текст локальная модель переводит: The local model translates a long text paragraph by paragraph. SearchAPI accepts at most 3000 characters at a time.
strings.Голосом: «переведи … на английский», «пе: By voice: “translate … into English”, “translate the selected text”, “install the translation model”, “cancel the download of the translation model”, “is the translation model installed?”.

strings.«Сбросить всё» также удалит подключения:: “Reset everything” also removes the connections: the Spotify, Gmail, Google Calendar, Yandex Music, Telegram and Discord tokens, API keys and Client IDs. “Keep connections” resets everything else.
strings.Настройки восстановлены по умолчанию, по: Settings were reset to their defaults; the connections were kept.

For example, name a playlist “Work” and say “Play playlist Work”. For Discord, add “in Discord” at the end of the command. Click Apply or Save to save your changes.

Border color of the active timer.

strings.По умолчанию создание, редактирование, п: By default, creating, editing, moving, renaming and deleting TO THE RECYCLE BIN run without confirmation. The switches above can require confirmation for these actions, and mass operations can show a preview. Permanent deletion, dangerous actions and protected system folders always need a separate confirmation or stay blocked.
strings.Открываю браузер для входа в Google… Раз: Opening the browser to sign in to Google… Allow access to Google Calendar and come back here.
Opening the browser to sign in to Google… Allow NEO to access Gmail and come back here.
strings.Действует на запросы к модели без собств: Applies to model requests that have no parameters of their own. Image analysis uses a fixed low variation so that descriptions stay accurate.
strings.Общий предел для запросов к модели без с: General limit for model requests without a limit of their own. Image analysis has its own limits: screen cards follow the performance profile, screen help gives a short answer, other screenshots use a separate image-analysis limit.
strings.Обычно модель изображений выгружается ср: Usually the image model is unloaded right after analysis. Screen cards are the exception: the performance profile may keep the model in memory for fast repeat answers (Low — no, Balanced — 2 min, Fast — 10 min, Maximum — 30 min).
strings.Настройки сохранены, но автозапуск Windo: The settings were saved, but Windows startup could not be applied. NEO will try again on the next save.
strings.Не удалось загрузить модель распознавани: Could not load the speech recognition model {model}. Text commands still work; choose another model or try again.
strings.Персональный словарь находится в разделе: The personal dictionary is in «Assistant → Microphone and wake word».
strings.Модель для разговора «{wanted}» не устан: The chat model “{wanted}” is not installed. Open the model settings and press “Download”.
